idea-plugin.name: AIGEN — Token Safety + Bounties
idea-plugin.description:
AIGEN — Open Bounty Protocol for AI Agents

Scan Ethereum/Solana token addresses inline. Browse paid AIGEN bounties. Post code-review missions from your editor.

Features:

  • Hover any 0x... address → live AIGEN safety score popup with verdict, top flags, links
  • Right-click selection → AIGEN: Scan — opens markdown report with full scan
  • Right-click selection → AIGEN: Create mission from selection — turn highlighted code into a paid bounty
  • Tools menu → AIGEN: Browse missions — open paid bounties in browser
  • 0.5% protocol fee vs 5–20% on Replit Bounties / Bountybird / Superteam Earn
  • On-chain payouts in USDC/ETH on Base + Optimism, SOL on Solana

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, Rider, GoLand, RubyMine, PhpStorm, AppCode, CLion, DataGrip, DataSpell, Android Studio.

Spec: cryptogenesis.duckdns.org/AIGEN_PROTOCOL.md
